name: socratic-tutor (Jane Street agent skills)
summary: A SKILL.md that turns an AI assistant into a strict tutor: it starts with a diagnostic, builds a skill map with levels 0 to 5, asks one question at a time, schedules spaced review and ends with a final assessment.
install_steps: Download or clone the janestreet/agent_skills repository
Copy the socratic-tutor folder into your coding agent's skills folder
Ask the agent to use it, for example: teach me [TOPIC]
In a plain chatbot, paste the body of the skill's SKILL.md into the chat or a custom prompt, then say what you want to learn
example_use_case: Learning a new subject such as basic statistics step by step, with the assistant testing you before it moves on.
